first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both currently declining, and prior evidence indicates that simplifying onboarding improves completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. This directly addresses the most proximal current constraints while supporting sustainable qualified revenue; promotional pricing merits verification because of the competitor response but may be less durable.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly addresses the simultaneous declines in onboarding completion and activation, while verified evidence shows higher completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and a 3% improvement in 30-day retention. Promotional pricing is ruled out as the primary sustainable-growth response because its verified retention decline undermines long-term qualified revenue.
